title: whois
body:
**REQUIRES: [Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

# WhoIs

Adds a command to show a player's skin, their username and their uuid.

# Commands:

|command|usage|
|-|-|
|/whois username <username>|Fetches that players information based on their current username|
|/whois uuid <uuid>|Fetches that players information based on their uuid (The uuid never changes, even after changing username)
